recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If the work group wants to further clarify where retired policyRule functionality belongs in R6, handle that through the unresolved current issue family rather than by changing this already-applied STU3 comment revision.
issue_request: FHIR-13735 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent. It asked to revise the poorly written Consent.policyRule comment, set the old policyRule definition to a specific base computable policy reference, set provision wording to constraints to Consent.policyRule, and state that absent policyRule computable consent must be constructed from Consent resource elements.
initial_application: Commit cf9f7092b2d0d538f29e0b989f5c63e50e0738f7 applied the request to the then-authoritative source/consent/consent-spreadsheet.xml by changing the old policyRule definition/comment and provision text. Later source migrations moved Consent definitions into source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml, and FHIR-13358 plus later Consent model work changed the literal policyRule representation.
additional_context: The current build no longer has an active Consent.policyRule element. source/fhir.ini keeps Consent active and records migration aliases from retired Consent.policy and Consent.policyRule paths to current elements. Later combined-branch reconciliations for FHIR-25387, FHIR-39597, and FHIR-45450 have already restored current-name policy fallback guidance, removed stale provision-zero wording, and aligned policyBasis with URI-based computable policy identifiers. FHIR-53724 is a later Triaged R6 issue about the missing policyRule concept and is not final enough to decide here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope Consent source already conveys the meaningful FHIR-13735 semantics: policyBasis identifies a computable backing policy, policyBasis carries fallback guidance when policyBasis/policyText are absent, provision is described as constraints/exceptions to the base policy, and Consent notes explain policyBasis/provision interaction. Reintroducing old policyRule wording would conflict with later current-model terminology.

related_jiras.note: Changed old Consent.policyRule from URI-style opt-in/opt-out usage to CodeableConcept examples, explaining why the STU3 wording did not remain literal.
Restored current-name guidance for absent policyBasis/policyText after retired policy/policyRule content was removed.
Refactored Consent provision/base-decision semantics and removed stale provision-zero wording.
Aligned current Consent.policyBasis wording with URI-based computable policy identifiers.
Later Triaged R6 issue questions where policyRule functionality went; it remains unresolved and was not decided.
